g.text: A persona card: who they are, what they need
one card per answer, and a role for each persona
persona card (template)
name
one-line description
behaviour: what they do, and when
needs and goals: what they want
pain points: what gets in the way
demographics or psychographics, tied to behaviour
a usage bucket alone is not enough
a 2x2 or a small table keeps it easy to follow
PRIMARY
design for this one first
highest value or largest unmet need
SECONDARY
served if it costs little extra
may need convincing
NEGATIVE
the person you will not focus on
naming them shows scope discipline
no research yet? a proto-persona: Goals, Motivation, Attitudes, Behaviours
